desc_en: A design conceived for distinction. This regular fit blazer features a flat lapel and long sleeves. Its graphic pattern introduces a bold character to the silhouette. A versatile garment for special occasions or formal wear. Each piece is made to order to ensure exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.

Una prenda versátil para ocasiones especiales o uso formal. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido para garantizar exclusividad. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
